QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is also off by default (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`)... The index also reports no definition site for `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`, so the "off" reading likely comes from a commented-out `#define`. Confirm against the header."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that both threading macros are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so a default build defines neither. The hedge about confirming against the header doesn't remove that claim.
